verdict.rationale: Sketch's official sketch-document GitHub repository documents the .sketch format as a zipped archive of JSON plus binary assets. A community report independently confirms the zipped-JSON format enables plugins and easy git integration. First-party docs also cover sketchtool and integrating Sketch into server applications on any platform, which supports tooling outside the editor. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-depth published schema or spec with format versioning details, and hands-on evidence of third-party tools reading or writing .sketch files without the Mac app.
